name: Dreams, Beasts, and Pomegranate Fruit
source:
An endless and cursed forest by a town near the edge of the world.

Do not leave the trail, she says.

Do not open the package, she says.

Do not return till the task is done, she says.

And a girl meets another girl.

[From [url=https://4noki.itch.io/dreams-beasts-and-pomegranate-fruit-alpha]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在靠近世界边缘的小镇旁，有一片无边无际、遭受诅咒的森林。

她说，不要偏离小路。

她说，不要打开包裹。

她说，没完成任务就不要回来。

而一个女孩，遇见了另一个女孩。

[摘自[url=https://4noki.itch.io/dreams-beasts-and-pomegranate-fruit-alpha]Itch.io[/url]]
